posts.title: Books Wot I Read in 2025
posts.description: It’s time for the yearly list of books I read and, in the process, reflecting on everything that’s happened. posts.title: “The Cleopatras” by Philip Mackie (1983)
posts.description: In 1983 the BBC tried to recapture some of the magic that had made I, Claudius such a success in the previous decade. What they came up with was The Cleopatras , a miniseries that follows the last hundred or so years of the Ptolemaic dynasty in Egypt, with a script by Philip Mackie.
